message.reasoning:
I need to decide whether to bid on or drop out of the Marvin Gardens auction.

I have $1014 and no monopolies. The auction is at $210 with a $211 minimum bid.

I previously declined the $280 purchase because owning no yellows would leave me with a scattered, weak set. A $211 bid would leave me with $803 cash. I am weighing whether to secure this foothold or keep the cash.

Other players have strong cash positions. A $220–$240 bid would be a solid discount on a good property. I still prefer completing my existing color groups over adding another incomplete set.

No yellow properties are owned yet. I still need Tennessee and New York Avenue to complete the orange group.

I own Indiana and Vermont, so I already have three single properties. Adding yellow would make four singles and spread my holdings too thin. p4 has $1475 and zero properties, so they will likely raise the bid further. I should drop out.

I considered bidding to inflate the price and then dropping out, but that contradicts my strategy. p4 will likely continue since they have the most cash and no properties. I will keep my liquidity for properties that complete my existing sets.
